card.name: With/of after faced, thought, prospect
card.fires_on: The small word "with" after "faced", and "of" after nouns like "thought", "prospect" or "bunch", in general web prose. Also occasionally partway through verbs like "churned" or "hurtling".

modes.label: faced with
modes.description: "with" right after "faced" introducing a challenge or choice.
modes.example: The DPRK by 1980 was faced<< with>> the choice of either repaying its international

modes.label: of after noun
modes.description: "of" after nouns like thought, prospect or bunch.
modes.example: The thought<< of>> spending a week or so quaffing

modes.label: verb endings
modes.description: Partway through motion verbs such as churned or hurtling.
modes.example: Our world is hurt<<ling>> toward carbon dioxide levels not seen since
